rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a sustained downward grind with no clear reversal structure — price moved from 17.36 to 17.19 with lower highs and lower lows, and the final candle's close at 17.19 is only marginally above the session low of 17.03, placing price at just 22% of the day's range. The spread of 58 bps is wide relative to the 5-minute ATR of ~$0.05, meaning the bid-ask friction alone consumes more than a full ATR, making any short-term directional trade structurally disadvantaged. With SPY down nearly 1% and VIXY up 3.85%, the broader risk-off environment adds uncertainty without a clean technical setup to justify the entry cost.
